answer_1.quote: Generative methods have been used to handle various ABSA tasks uniformly and achieved good performance ... We conduct extensive experiments on main aspect sentiment tuple prediction tasks, including ASQP, ACOS, ASTE and TASD.
answer_1.outputs: Sentiment tuples consisting of aspect term, aspect category, opinion term, and sentiment polarity (a, c, o, s)

answer_2.quote: For all ABSA tasks, a predicted sentiment tuple is considered as correct if and only if all its elements are exactly the same as the gold tuple. We use F1 scores as the main evaluation metrics.
